name: Volume
description: The default output's volume. Scroll to change it, middle-click to mute, click for sliders; Plasma's own mixer is one click further.

step.label: Scroll step
step.description: Percent per notch of the wheel.

maxVolume.label: Loudest by scrolling
maxVolume.description: Scrolling and the slider stop here. Above 100 is amplification, which can distort.

showMicrophone.label: Show the microphone
showMicrophone.description: A second slider in the popout, for the default input.
